coordinate_system: normalized 0-1; x from left, y from top; north up
note: Player-facing continental layer: established major cities, principal seats, major fortresses, and major ports only. Smaller settlements are intentionally reserved for regional maps or GM reference. Coordinates remain approximate and require visual review against the authoritative atlas. Political borders are deliberately omitted until non-overlapping boundaries are mapped and approved.

import_instructions.marker_location_link: Synchronize markers by source_id and preserve the linked campaign_locations.id when a marker is renamed.
import_instructions.resolve_campaign_id: Use the authenticated GM's active campaign_id; do not hard-code a campaign UUID.
import_instructions.upsert_key: Stable map_source_id and per-marker/per-overlay source_id, scoped to the authenticated campaign.
import_instructions.visibility: Each marker explicitly declares player_visible. The 15 approved major places are public; GM notes remain private. No political or geographic overlays are included because the current draft polygons are not reliable boundaries. Add overlays only after classifying and mapping them according to atlas_overlay_standards.md.
import_instructions.caution: Do not create or expose the GM-only dwarven underground route to Dragonstone. Do not add minor settlement markers to the continental layer merely to populate empty space; place them on their appropriate regional maps.

marker_navigation.current_behavior: Atlas marker click currently selects marker only; it does not navigate to a map.
marker_navigation.recommended_behavior: On marker activation, if exactly one child map of the selected map has the same location_id as the marker and has artwork, navigate to that child map. Otherwise show/select marker normally.
tallowmere_hierarchy: Tallowmere regional map: parent_map_id=continent map; location_id=Tallowmere location id
Tallowmere city map: parent_map_id=regional map; location_id=Tallowmere location id
marker_navigation.breadcrumb_behavior: Preserve navigation back from city to region to continent.
